chapter.verse: Tua khit ciangin, Jerusalem khua panin hong tung Farisaite leh laithei kimkhatte in Zeisu kiangah hong kikhawm uh a,
a nungzui kimkhatte in a nin cihnopna, a kisil lo khut tawh an ne uh a mu uh hi.
(Farisaite akipan Judah mi khempeuh in tanglai upate’ ngeina zui-in khut phatakin sil loin an ne lo uh hi.
Sumbuk panin hong ciah uh ciangin zong pumpi kisil loin an ne lo uh hi. Tua lo adang ngeinate in haite, sumngo kuangte, dalkuangte tui tawh sawpna ngeina a zuih uh tampi a om hi).
Farisaite leh laitheite in, “Tanglai upate’ ngeina na nungzuite in zui loin, khut nin tawh bang hangin an ne ahi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Isaiah in mi simtat note tungah a kituakin a genkhol zo hi. Tua Lai Siangtho in: ‘Hih mipawlte in amau kam uh tawh kei hong zahtak uh hangin, A lungsim uh kei tawh kigam la hi.
Mite thukham ngeina a hilh uh a, A mawkna in kei hong bia uh hi,’ a ci hi.
Note in Pasian thukham na paai uh a, mite kiang pan na ngah uh ngeina na zui uh hi.”
“Note in na ngeina uh na zuih theih nadingun Pasian’ thukham na nial uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Moses in, ‘Na nu leh na pa na zahtak in. A nu a pa a gensiate in sihna thuak ta hen,’ a ci hi.
Note in na cihna uh ah, keima kiangah na zat theih keima sum, Pasian kipia zo cihnopna ahi, ‘Korban’ hi ci-in mi khatin a cih leh,
tua mi in a nu a pate tungah neukha beek bawl theih loh na’ng na kham uh a,
na kipiak ngeina uh zui-in Pasian thu na mawk valsak uh hi. Tua bang gamtatna tampi na zui uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in mihonpite sam kik a, “Note khempeuh in ngai un la, na thei ta un.
Mi sungah a pua lam pan a lutsuk na in mi a ninsak zo na khat beek a om kei hi.
Mi sung pan a paikhiate in mi a ninsak thei hi, zak nading bil a nei mi in za ta hen” a ci hi.
Zeisu in mihonpi lak pan kikhen a, inn sungah a lut khit ciangin, a nungzuite in tua thungentehna a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Note in zong lungpilna nei nai lo na hi uh hiam? Mi pua lam pan a sungah a lut khempeuh in, mi a ninsak zo lo thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ama lung sungah lut loin a gilpi sungah tumsuk a, gil sung pan a kithakhia hi,” a ci hi. Tua bang a gen ciangin sa khempeuh a siangthosak hi.
Khatvei Zeisu in, “Mi sung pan a paikhiate in mi a ninsak thei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mi sung pan a hoih lo ngaihsutna, numei tawh mawhna,
mi’ sum gukna, mi thahna, mi’ zi tungah mawhna, huaihamna, gitlohna, mi kheemna, kihhuai deihna, een’na,
mi gensiatna, kiphatsakna, mawktatna, hih gitlohna khempeuh in sung lam pan a paikhia uh a, mi a ninsak uh hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu tua mun pan tho a, Tai-ar leh Sidon khua nai lamah a pai ciangin, inn khatah lut a, kuamah in a theih loh nading a ut hangin bu-in a kiseel zo kei hi.
A tanu sungah dawi lut numei khat in Zeisu a om thu a zak ciangin, thakhatin hong pai a, a khe kiangah bokin,
a tanu’ sung pan dawi a hawlkhiat nading thu a ngen hi. Tua numei in Sirofoenisia pawl, Grik numei ahi hi.
Zeisu in, “Amasa-in tate kivak kham ta hen. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, tate an nek ding la a, uite piak ding kilawm lo hi,” a cih leh,
numei in, “Ahi mah hi, Topa aw, uite in tate anneng kiate sabuai nuai-ah a ne uh hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Tua thu hangin nang pai in, na tanu’ sung pan dawi a paikhia zo hi,” a ci hi.
Numei a innah ciah a, numeino in lupna tungah lum a, dawi a paikhia zo cih a mu hi.
Zeisu in Tai-ar gam pan paikhia a, Sidon gam a paltan khit ciangin, Dekapolis gam paisuakin Galile tuili a tung kik hi.
Tua lai takin bengngong, paumawl mi khat a kiangah a paipih uh a, ama tungah a khut a ngak nadingin a thuum uh hi.
Zeisu in tua pa mihonpi lak pan samkhia a, gam daihna munah a paipih khit ciangin, a khutmete a bil lang nih sungah guangin, a cil phih a, a leii zong a lawng hi.
Vantung ento-in khuisa a, kihong ta hen cihnopna-in “Effatha” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin mipa a bil kihong a, a leii gui kikhah khia-in pha takpi-in kam a pau thei hi.
Tua thu kuamah kiangah a gen loh nadingin amaute a kham hi. A kham semsem hangin, amaute in tua thu a tangko semsem uh hi.
Amaute in a kigen thei lo zah dongin lamdang a sa uh a, “Amah in na khempeuh phatakin a bawl zo hi. Bengngongte khua zasak zo a, pau thei lote a pausak thei zo hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi.
